piko_newx_tools_history_summary: Posts opened and videos watched, including swipes in the video viewer. Stored only on this device.
查看打开过的帖子和观看过的视频，包括在视频页滑动观看的视频。仅存本机。
piko_newx_tools_history_enabled_summary: Off by default. Records opened posts and videos as soon as they become the foreground current page, even when paused; excludes prefetch and DMs. Turning off stops new records, but does not erase existing history.
默认关闭。记录打开的帖子；视频成为前台当前页即记录，暂停也算，不记录预加载和私信。关闭后停止新增，但不删除已有历史。
piko_newx_tools_history_days_summary: Pruned on the next history read or write. Up to 5,000 records.
下次读取或写入历史时清理，最多保留 5,000 条。
piko_newx_tools_history_search: Search post text, author or post ID
搜索帖子文字、作者或帖子 ID
piko_newx_tools_history_empty: No matching history. Recording starts only after you enable it.
没有匹配的历史。开启记录后才开始保存。
piko_newx_tools_history_limit: Showing up to 300 recent matches. Open links use your current X account; an unavailable post cannot be recovered.
最多显示最近 300 条匹配记录。原帖以当前 X 账号打开；无法恢复不可访问的帖子。
piko_newx_tools_history_clear_confirm: Delete all local post and video history? This does not delete bookmarks or downloaded files.
删除本机全部帖子和视频浏览历史？不会删除书签或已下载文件。
piko_newx_tools_downloads_summary: Track Piko downloads, retry failures and open saved files or source posts.
查看 Piko 下载任务、重试失败任务、打开已保存文件或原帖。
piko_newx_tools_video_tools_summary: Playback position, speed and touch lock in the video viewer.
视频页的播放进度、倍速和防误触锁定。
piko_newx_tools_download_clear_confirm: Remove completed task records? Downloaded files will not be deleted.
清理已完成任务的记录？不会删除已下载的文件。
piko_newx_tools_download_empty: 暂无 Piko 下载记录。
piko_newx_tools_download_limit: Latest 300 Piko tasks. Tap for actions. Android manages waiting and network retries.
最近 300 条 Piko 下载任务。点击可操作；等待和网络重试由系统管理。
piko_newx_tools_download_retry_failed: Could not retry. Check storage, network and the existing-file policy.
无法重试，请检查存储、网络和同名文件处理设置。
piko_newx_tools_state_paused: Waiting for network or system retry
piko_newx_tools_reason_enqueue: Could not submit the download to Android.
无法向系统提交下载任务。
piko_newx_tools_reason_finalize: File saving failed. Retry saves the existing download without fetching it again.
文件保存失败；重试会重新保存已有下载，不重复传输。
piko_newx_tools_reason_missing: The system download record is no longer available.
系统下载记录已不存在。
piko_newx_tools_resume_video_summary: Resume the same video on this device. Manual seeking takes priority; near-finished videos start normally. Native speed memory and long-press acceleration are unchanged.
在本机续播同一视频。手动拖动优先；接近播完的视频正常重新开始。原生倍速记忆和长按加速保持不变。
piko_newx_tools_touch_lock_summary: Lock touch controls in the foreground video viewer. Unlock remains visible; system Back can still exit.
锁定前台视频页的触摸操作。解锁按钮始终可见，系统返回仍可退出。
